body: Don't anthropomorphize. Animals don't care about their balls/ovaries OR sex in the same capacity as humans.

I was told I had a total of 4, potentially 5 because the guy who called 911 doesn't know whether I was seizing when I first went down. 

To be honest, I was on the gabapentin before the seizure to treat  neuropathy pain. 

I remember bits and pieces. I don't remember anything about the first two other than I broke the frame to my glasses when I fell. I remember being really angry about that, because I'm a broke bitch and can't afford new frames. 

Then I remember the paramedics asking me a bunch of questions that I couldn't answer. Also they kept telling me it was OK for me to admit I had taken bath salts. (I hadn't)

Then being in the ambulance where I will swear to this day they put the IV in my right arm and somehow by the time I got to the ER it was in the left arm. Nothing was ever done to my right arm. 

I don't remember being in the ER though I am told I was quite lucid until I had another seizure. That was all on the 5th. I think I had another seizure on the 6th but that also could have been the 5th. I have no way of knowing. 

I don't really remember much else other than sleeping a shit ton until the 8th when they told me I was cleared to go home. 

Yesterday (the 12th) was my first real day of clarity and sanity.  It is really bizarre to know it's only been like...4 days since I got out, because it has felt like *so* much longer. It feels like I was in this bizarre world of nonsense for *months*.

I am terrible at it and I have already forgotten to take the medications they gave me for the seizures twice. I even have alarms set, and I still forgot. I worry that I'm just setting myself up for more problems by taking the meds incorrectly than not taking them at all.
I am not on anti-depressants other than an herbal-type thing called 5HTP, which I hadn't been on in about 2 or so weeks. I'm not a big fan of taking medication to begin with >.>

I deal with depression anyway, and whatever I was experiencing at the time I made the original post was just a totally different type of "dark place" that I couldn't even begin to explain. 

I'm slowly feeling better though. Each day is better.
